satisfied_inclusion_points: Paper is a full research article in English with full text available (preprint for Expert Systems With Applications).
Paper is a primary research article presenting original contributions (pipeline, dataset, and tool).
Paper specifically covers NLP-based extraction of decision/process models from natural-language text (DMN models).
Paper explicates concrete methods (BERT and Bi-LSTM-CRF classifiers/extractors) and reports empirical validation on labeled datasets and real examples.
evidence_highlights: Title/abstract and full text: 'This paper studies how NLP deep learning techniques can extract decision models from text faster.'
Contributions: 'The first complete pipeline to extract DMN models from text using deep learning is introduced.'
Methods: 'we study and evaluate an automatic sentence classifier and a decision dependency extractor using NLP deep learning models (BERT and Bi-LSTM-CRF).'
Dataset/tool: 'A large labeled and tagged dataset was collected from real use cases ...' and 'the first DMN model extraction tool from text using deep learning is also made available.'
Evaluation: Sections 5–7 report experiments, quantitative results (precision/recall/F1) on sentence-level tagging and full examples.
decision_rationale: The full text is an English full research article that presents original research focused on extracting Decision Model and Notation (decisional) models from natural-language text using NLP deep-learning methods. It provides a concrete pipeline, datasets, implementation (tool), and empirical evaluations. These facts directly satisfy the Stage 2 inclusion criteria (paper type, originality, NLP for process/decision-model extraction, concrete method and experiments); no exclusion criteria are triggered.
candidate_title: Extracting Decision Model and Notation models from text using deep learning techniques
